svg.title: A clearer route from discovery to your business.
svg.desc: In a later illustrative answer, your business is one option to compare. The same blue buyer boat takes a long approach, reads your page and visits a berth. Other buyers continue toward other businesses.

g.text: A clearer route from discovery to your business.
Return to the buyer’s point of view and close the loop.
They choose to explore your bay.
They arrive at a clear next step.
BOAT = POTENTIAL CLIENT · BAY = BUSINESS · GREY LOGO = DISCOVERY CHANNEL
